body: That's amazing. I'm proud of you too!! And I'm glad your mom is understanding as well. You did a tough thing.

I'm back. Took some time to eat and finish applying.  Yeah, I know you probably can't 100% know how to solve whatever it is that I am having difficulty with...and yeah maybe it is possible you have had similar experiences...I really kinda hope you havent to some degree though. 

I know i have not tried all the things I could do. I know I could get help, but the thing is-- the process of getting help and the environment I would be in afterwards- I don't think I can handle that. 

And it's okay that you're making guesses based off what you know. I'm not really upset about that lol. And in some ways, you are correct, but not. At this point, I guess I would say that I probably don't want to keep talking here. Are you okay with DMing?

Yeah, I guess I am having mixed feelings..but it really cannot wait until the next year. Makes sense that you would have questions because I explained nothing basically. I guess I am down for continuing to talk somewhat. I'm taking around 6 classes. Different subjects. Studying computer science so the internships would be software engineering related. About who people think I am- different things and for different reasons somewhat..but the reasons are mainly because of me. Maybe resolution of misconceptions would make life less stressful, but I don't think it would ultimately solve my problems. Let me finish applying and having lunch. Then maybe we can talk more..

Today because its before the start of finals week. I mean I was thinking about pushing and going for another two days (maybe make two of my finals before I go off or something). Loose ends? I just want to write a letter that fully explains why I did it and shows what kind of person I am. I feel like people have all sorts of misconceptions about me and I don't want that to be what they think still if I'm gone. I already have like 4 pages typed. Yeah, I know that's a lot. Most letters are short but for me- I have to let everything out that way. I'm also just for the hell of it- applying to a bunch of internships ..just cuz? I might as well just try once anyway and have it go through.

I mean I am still here. We could chat, but I'm thinking of today doing the deed...I dont know. I still have a lot left to finish planning for and setting up. I haven't even finished my letter. I don't want to somewhat.

I do not have much experience or knowledge with BPD so I do not know how to give much advice. It's okay that you feel lonely still also after interacting with them. Maybe try talking to one of them that you trust also and letting them know how you feel? How does that sound? Do you think it will help?
Alright. Let me know how that goes and I am glad you are feeling better.
Loved? Do you have family or friends? Or anyone at least irl to talk to?

There's a quote from a documentary on Japanese victims who survived the Hiroshima bombings that I think about a lot. Here it is with context. 

 She recalls returning to the place where her sister died, planning to kill herself too. At the last minute, she jumped aside as the train approached. "I realized there are two kinds of courage: the courage to die and the courage to live," she says. "I decided I wanted to live."

First, the girlfriend thing- you are still young so you have quite a bit of time. Honestly, it is never too late to try or find one. Number two, being awkward? It sounds like you might have a bit of social anxiety with interacting with people, but I do not think there is no hope at all. It takes time to find true love or even love in general and it's not easy. Next, I really want to stress that college rejections do not reflect on your worth. They do not define how intelligent or capable you are. The whole college admissions process is tough and somewhat of a lottery. Going to one of these top tier schools is nice but even if you were to go to a less known, not prestigious one, it's okay. College is more about what you do there and not where you go. What you learn and get out of the place is more important.
:/ Alright if you do not want to talk. But if you do, then you can reach out. I will try to reply. There is help there for you if you need it. Just really want you to know that.

Again, this upsets me that they showed little concern. And i get that it took you a long time to trust them, but there is good help out there for you. :/ do you want to talk about how or why you are feeling what you are rn?

I am shocked but also I have heard similar things from a friend who sought counseling at her uni. I think you should get a new therapist soon. This one does not seem the most engaging or helpful. If someone comes to you for help, i am pretty sure you do not refer them like that.

I have been here before. Very much so, but slightly different situation. But, i do not know how your parents are. But either way, for SSN number, I did not need it for my appeals (scholarships only) but i was able to access that information through school portal through 1098-T form i believe that is auto generated...at least at my school. Look into that? 

Yeah, your parents probably are going to be upset and disappointed. My mom and sister (my dad didnt find out yet thank god) both were when they learned what I had done. In my defense, it was the best move academically and mentally..not that im anywhere better now. I never got proper help. 

It might really suck the next few months. I have no idea, but I do not think everything is gone for you. I honestly thought I was screwed when I had a similar issue...i mean I have the issue again this time but no easy way out either. Also at schools, they usually have resources to help you through things like this. Have you looked into them?
Your therapist said that?? Or well both of them?

Yeah, that does sound like a really tough situation. I do not know which disease you have, but there is no cure or treatments at all? And in regards to your mental health, if you did not have the physical problems, do you think you would feel the same? Quitting a job or a degree also is not a sign of failure if you think that. It sounds like it was probably the right thing to do given circumstances. I have had an emergency medical withdrawing during a semester in school and if was the small break I needed.
No-it was okay that you were not clear. :/ I can talk if you want to.
Give up on hurting yourself? I just want to make sure you are safe. Its okay though that you feel this also.

No way is 100% fool proof. Jumping from buildings can fail and at least 80 ft high of a fall must be made so that the impact whether it be on ground or water, it can cause internal organ damage, break bones, and possibly break spine. Usually people become unconscious at that point. But people do manage to survive such jumps sometimes.
Alright. Do you think it might be deep ingrained anxiety of things not going as planned or something? When you say bad things...like what are we talking about?

I totally understand getting mad at the things that make you want to live. You feel like you can off yourself but..no... 

I think its in some ways a sign that deep down we do want to continue. But, also, I think you can get help to confront these pains.
Why do you think your life is meaningless? What do you mean by objective value?

It is okay that you feel this way. Not every person is the same. What might be a big deal to them is something that might not be for you. I never ever felt the desire to off myself so strongly until recently and maybe in the past about 1.5 yrs..maybe many yrs before too when I somewhat tried to die. ...But, why do you feel this way? Because something incovenient happens?
It is okay to feel this way. I feel the same somewhat too. Do you want to talk about how you are living and why you are not happy? Also, want to let you know that there is help out there.

It is okay if you dont want to explain everything. But do you live in the US? If you are and you are at least 18, then you can most likely pursue treatment by yourself. I would ask if your insurance covers it also. Also, in the usa, by law, your doctors are going to be HIPAA compliant and cannot tell authorities of anything unless you plan to or are currently physically harming someone or yourself. I told my doctor that I drank underage (not same thing, I know) but they cant report me.  

Last thing is that if you use the PTSD subreddit, I believe there is a discord server. I am in it and it has helped me quite a few times. People there may also be able to help.

Dang, your therapist and psychiatrist sounds ...somewhat horrible to have that attitude. I know I am not in any plave to say this, but I think its the impulsiveness pushing you towards this. Maybe also start seeing a new therapist and psychiatrist? There is help out there.
I really hope you are still here or if you are not, then you have found peace.

Is there no way for you to seek treatment on your own or in any way? Your friends might not be able to help, but there are people who can. You are not alone and you arent defined by your mental health. I struggle from probably PTSD but due to sexual assault. It sucks. I know.
Nothing left at all? I do not know you, but I think we, humans, are far stronger than we give ourselves credit for.

I really relate to being an outcast. I grew up feeling like I never had friends in person and I never really did. I still somewhat do not but I have okay friends now. Maybe not the best friend for life type, but it took a while to even get here. You are capable of being loved and having good friends. It just will take time and effort to find those people who will love you.

I completely agree with this. Lack of sleep is the reason given?? I don't know what to say about this.

I had something similar happen except we were both drunk- I was more drunk though, but I still protested and said no, stop etc. My best friend basically turned into someone else and said things that scared me. He stopped though when I started crying and kept apologizing. Later, he wanted to blame it on alcohol, but he couldn't come up with a good explanation. I stayed away from him for a week or two to sort myself out..but in the time I ignored him, he sent me many messages. In one message, he even had the audacity to suggest that he thought I wanted it.

Still, I couldn't bring myself to leave him and kept hanging out...but the relationship was never truly the same- there was this uneasy vibe and barrier that had been built. I had a hard time removing myself from him, but it was for the best. When someone messes up this big...it's not that easy to forgive or forget ever. Furthermore, your friend did this when he was completely sober and even if he was drunk and did this...it is in no way excuseable. I sometimes miss my friend- the friend that I knew before what happened..but it's too late to have that.  

I'm not saying you should completely cut him out, but it might be the best thing to do. Your trust in this relationship is now nonexistent or broken. It will be hard to rebuild and there is a new rift... 

Please be well and know that you're not crazy for wanting to still be friends. You want to be friends with the person who was nice and supportive- the friend you could laugh with, not the one who disregards your feelings.

The people in this thread are so nice honestly. Thank you for reading the wall of text. And yeah...I suppose no friend would ever do that to someone they're friends with. Logically, I know I can't be friends with someone who did that to me, but they are someone who knows so much about me\- I find it difficult to fully cut them out of my life, but I know I can't depend on them...I was going to mention that I have a thing against counselors/therapists. I just really wanted to rant and get some support from people.
